sampling.algorithm: SHA-256 ranking without replacement; ascending digest then exact UTF-8 relative path
sampling.hash_input: UTF-8(domain) + NUL + ASCII(seed_hex_text) + NUL + UTF-8(relative preset path)
sampling.note: Unbiased pseudorandom sample by path; no feature filtering, duplicate-content rejection, or rerolling.

asset_policy: Copy all packaged textures to preserve dynamic/random lookup candidates; missing external references remain possible. Texture root is shared and unchanged.
